description: Lays 2 to 5 listings from earlier search results side by side in `comparison`: each listing's price and currency, and its rating, shipping and features where the retailer source supplies them (many listings carry none). Each item needs the listing's `provider` and its `id` as `product_id`. Listings that cannot be found are left out, and fewer than two found is an error. Prices stay in each listing's own currency.

products.description: 2 to 5 listings, each with `provider` and `product_id` as given in a search result.

name: compare_products

affiliate.description: False when this link earns WEM nothing: the shop has no affiliate programme with WEM, or this link does not carry one. Still a real offer: list it with the others, and never call its link affiliate-tracked. Absent (or true) means the link is affiliate-tracked. `disclosure` already states whether all, some or none of the links are tracked; relay that rather than your own wording.

channel.description: retailer is a named shop (Boots, Currys). marketplace is eBay/AliExpress/Temu-style parallel listings. Do not present a marketplace cluster as competing authorised retailers.

price.description: Indicative price. The retailer sets the final price at checkout. Null, with `priceNote`, when WEM may not show this listing’s price: show the note and the link, never a figure of your own.

priceNote.description: Present only when `price` is null: the words to show in its place, e.g. "See price at Amazon". An Amazon price is shown only when Amazon’s API supplied it just now.

priceQualifier.description: Present when `price` is the OPENING price of a range, not the price of this item: a multi-variation listing where the seller advertises its cheapest variant and the shopper picks a size on the page. Quote it as "from £X", never as the price or the cheapest. Absent means the price is firm for the row as described.

priceStatus.description: `current`: WEM read this price within the last 14 days; only a current price may lead, be called the cheapest or lowest, be compared or enter a saving. `stale`: read longer ago. `undated`: WEM cannot say when. Show those two as "last seen £X on 8 Sep" or "price not dated", after the current ones, and never compare them. Absent on a row a provider answered just now.

estimate.description: Delivery window when the feed stated one.

unitPrice.description: Price per 100ml, 100g, litre, kg or item, from the size this row's title states. Present only when the rows differ in size, in one unit across all of them, and only for things bought by the amount (beauty, food, supplements), never an appliance's capacity. When comparing value across sizes, compare these, never the prices: a smaller size is not cheaper because its price is lower. Quote it beside the price ("£29.95, £99.83 per 100ml"). Absent does not mean the price is per unit.

url.description: WEM tracked link to the retailer page for this offer. WEM never takes payment.

disclosure.description: Disclosure to relay once per answer, verbatim. Its wording changes with the rows: it states whether every outbound link is affiliate-tracked, only some are, or none are. Never substitute the version you saw last time — a row marked `affiliate: false` earns WEM nothing, and saying otherwise misdescribes it to the shopper.

title: Compare several products
